medicines.statusLabel: Discontinued (ARTG cancelled)
medicines.mechanism: Cancelled under Section 30(1)(c) of the Therapeutic Goods Act

medicines.statusLabel: PBS access being extended (was due to end 1 Nov 2026)
medicines.expectedReturn: access change, not a manufacturing shortage
medicines.mechanism: PBS funding/access change, per TGA/PBS and AstraZeneca notices
medicines.note: Zoladex 3.6 mg was due to leave the PBS on 1 November 2026. AstraZeneca has since told the TGA it will keep supplying it and extend PBS access, and it is not on the PBS deletions list for 1 November 2026; ask the pharmacist for the current position. This site will check this again after 1 November 2026. Triptorelin 3.75 mg (Diphereline) has had no PBS restriction since 1 October 2026, but its listing is not for use in gender dysphoria in minors.
